title: classerealmplugin
description: add 5 classes each with its own weapon
body:
⚔️ ClassRealm: The Ultimate Lite RPG Experience
ClassRealm is a lightweight, high-performance RPG plugin for Minecraft 1.21. It introduces a class-based progression system designed to enhance survival gameplay without the lag or complexity of larger "bloated" plugins.

🌟 Key Features
Unique Class System: Choose your destiny with one of 5 distinct classes (Warrior, Mage, Archer, Crusader, and Assassin).

Soulbound Weaponry: Every class receives a specialized starter weapon that is bound to their soul—it cannot be dropped or traded!

Custom Scaling: Experience custom damage, health, and mana mechanics tailored to your specific class level.

Simple & Fast: Built on the Paper API for maximum performance, ensuring zero impact on server TPS.

📜 Commands
/rpg help - View all available RPG commands.

/rpg info - View your current class, level, and stats.

/rpg select <class> - Choose your starting class (One-time choice!).

/rpg admin <give/set> - Admin tools for managing player progress.

🛠️ Installation
Download the ClassRealm.jar from the target folder.

Upload the file to your server's /plugins folder (works perfectly on FalixNodes).

Restart your server.

Type /plugins to confirm ClassRealm is active!
